questions.section: Part Two: Structured Questions (60 marks)
questions.question:
8. prove the following identities
  a) sin 2x / (1 − cos 2x) = cot x (3 mark)
  b) Sec⁴ ∅ - sec² ∅ = tan⁴ ∅ + tan² ∅
questions.answer_guide:
a) LHS = 2 sin x cos x / (1 − (1 − 2sin²x)) = 2 sin x cos x / (2 sin²x) = cos x / sin x = cot x ∎
b) LHS = sec²∅(sec²∅ − 1) = (1 + tan²∅)(tan²∅) = tan²∅ + tan⁴∅ = RHS ∎
